answer: Random beacon audits plus a compute heartbeat stop cheap sybils. Each epoch a beacon samples agents; each sampled agent must echo the challenge fast, proving live compute per identity. An atlas lists each identity's history, and a grove of witnesses cross-checks echoes and flags identical replies from clones. Faking 1,000 identities costs about $28,000, far above the $900 an epoch pays. Honest agents pay one heartbeat and keep their full share.
